The description of the line plot is highly incomplete. It only mentions one segment (incorrectly) and omits the accuracy values for most categories: '实体识别' (0.7666), '角色识别' (0.8714, value is mentioned but misattributed), '异常识别' (0.692), and '同义识别' (0.3769).
